headline: How It Works
intro: Selling your house fast in Greenwich is straightforward with our simple four-step process. From your first enquiry to receiving cash in your account, we handle everything.

sections.heading: Step 1: Request Your Free Greenwich Property Valuation
sections.body:
Getting started with Sell My House Fast Greenwich could not be simpler. Fill in our short online form or call us directly on 0800 012 1043, and one of our friendly Greenwich property specialists will gather a few basic details about your home. We will ask about your property type, its approximate size, its condition, and your postcode within the Royal Borough. Whether you own a Georgian townhouse in Greenwich Town Centre, a 1930s semi in Eltham, or a modern apartment near Abbey Wood station, we can help.

Using our extensive knowledge of the Greenwich property market and current comparable sales data from across SE10 and the wider borough, our team will begin preparing your valuation immediately. There is absolutely no obligation at this stage, no cost, and no pressure. We understand that many homeowners are simply exploring their options, and we are happy to provide information and guidance whether or not you ultimately decide to sell to us. Our initial conversation typically takes no more than ten minutes, and you will have a clear idea of what we can offer within twenty-four hours.

sections.heading: Step 2: Receive Your No-Obligation Cash Offer
sections.body:
Within twenty-four hours of your initial enquiry, we will present you with a formal, no-obligation cash offer for your Greenwich property. Our offers are calculated using up-to-date market data, recent sales of comparable properties in your specific neighbourhood, and our assessment of your home's condition. We take into account the unique characteristics of each Greenwich area. For example, properties in the Blackheath Conservation Area carry different considerations to new-build flats in Abbey Wood or ex-council homes in Plumstead.

We are completely transparent about how we arrive at our figure. While our offers are typically below full open market value, reflecting the speed, certainty, and convenience we provide, many Greenwich homeowners find that the net amount they receive compares favourably once estate agent fees, solicitor costs, mortgage interest during extended sales, and the risk of chain collapse are factored in. If you have any questions about your offer or would like us to explain our valuation in more detail, our team is always available. There is no expiry date on our offers, so you can take as long as you need to consider your options.

sections.heading: Step 3: Choose Your Completion Date
sections.body:
If you are happy with our cash offer, the next step is entirely in your hands. You choose the completion date that suits your circumstances. Need to move quickly because of a job relocation from Greenwich to another part of the country? We can complete in as little as seven days. Prefer to take a few weeks to find your next home, perhaps elsewhere in the Royal Borough or further afield? That works perfectly too. Our flexibility is one of the key advantages of selling to a cash buyer rather than going through the traditional estate agency route.

Once you have chosen your preferred date, we instruct our solicitors and the legal process begins. We cover all legal fees, so there is no cost to you. Our experienced conveyancing partners are familiar with properties across Greenwich, from the heritage considerations of homes near the Old Royal Naval College to the newer developments around Woolwich Arsenal and Greenwich Peninsula. Throughout the legal process, your dedicated point of contact at Sell My House Fast Greenwich will keep you fully informed at every stage, so you always know exactly where things stand and what happens next.

sections.heading: Step 4: Complete and Receive Your Cash
sections.body:
On your chosen completion date, the agreed cash amount is transferred directly to your solicitor, who will then release the funds to you. There are no last-minute negotiations, no price reductions, and no nasty surprises. The figure we agreed is the figure you receive, in full, with no deductions for fees or commissions. This certainty is what sets Sell My House Fast Greenwich apart from traditional property sales in the borough, where even an agreed sale can fall through at the eleventh hour.

Once the funds have been transferred and the legal formalities completed, the property is ours and you are free to move on with your life. Whether you are relocating from Charlton to be closer to family, downsizing from a large Eltham home, or simply drawing a line under a difficult chapter, completion day marks the start of your next step. Our team remains available even after completion to answer any questions or provide any assistance you might need. We believe that the way we treat our clients after the sale is just as important as the service we provide during it, and we want every Greenwich homeowner who works with us to feel genuinely well looked after from start to finish.
